That Makes Sense now supports **Minecraft 1.21.8** (Fabric + NeoForge) — the full feature set from the 26.x release, adapted to 1.21.8.

## Added
- **Craftable Name Tag** — craft a name tag from paper + an iron nugget on a crafting table (1.21.8 has no vanilla name-tag recipe). Toggle it in the config.

## Notes
- Every quality-of-life tweak from the 26.x version carries over. The only omission is the copper-chest tweak, which can't exist here — copper chests weren't added to Minecraft until 1.21.9.
